description: Line Plume draws line and area charts on a real time axis. Put a date, a number or a category on the X axis, one or more measures in Values and, if you like, a Legend field for one line per channel, product or region. Hover anywhere: a single tooltip lists every series for that date. Free features, no watermark Time axis: dates spaced by their real gap, calendar ticks from years down to hours; numbers and categories work too. Lines and areas: straight, smooth or stepped lines, solid or stacked areas; gaps, zeros or joined points for missing values. Markers and labels: all points, last, first and last, min and max; labels that never overlap. Two Y axes: a secondary axis, also with a legend; logarithmic scale, custom min and max. Per-series settings: line style, width, shape, markers and labels for each line; premium options series by series too. Interact: crosshair tooltip, click a point or the legend to cross-filter, Ctrl + click, right-click menu, keyboard navigation. Dynamic formatting: drive any Format pane setting with a DAX measure. For everyone: screen readers, high contrast, reduced motion, English and French. Your colors: follows the report theme; custom colors; Minimal and Black & White styles. Premium features ★ Trends and forecasts: linear, polynomial, exponential, logarithmic, power, Holt or seasonal Holt-Winters, per series, with an 80% or 95% forecast interval…
